title: Pangu Creates the World
synopsis: Learn about how the world came to be in Chinese mythology.

fullText.simplified:
盘古开天地

    在太古时期，天地一片黑暗，分不清上下左右，东南西北。整个天地就像一颗巨大无比的“鸡蛋”。
    不知道从什么时候起，“鸡蛋”里孕育出了一个生命。这个生命就是中国的创世神——盘古。盘古在黑乎乎的“鸡蛋”中沉睡了一万八千年。
    一万八千年后，盘古慢慢地睁开了眼睛。他发现眼前除了黑暗还是黑暗。他想伸展一下手和脚，却被“鸡蛋”包裹得紧紧的。盘古觉得非常不舒服，他想要打破这个“鸡蛋”。
    于是他用自己的牙齿变了一把神斧。他拿起神斧用力地一砍，这颗“鸡蛋”居然裂开了，神奇的事情发生了。“鸡蛋”中比较轻的部分开始慢慢上升变成了天，比较重的部分慢慢下沉变成了地。盘古顿时觉得轻松了许多。
    可是没过一会儿，天又开始下沉了，地也在上升。很快天和地又要合在一起了。于是盘古赶紧用手举着天，脚踩着地，把天和地分开。天和地每天在不断地上升和下沉，盘古的身体也随之长高。又过了一万八千年，天和地再也没有合并的迹象了。
    于是盘古放下举着天空的双手。他看了看世界，觉得世界什么都没有，空空的。于是，他用自己的左眼变成了火红的太阳，用自己的右眼变成了银色的月亮。他的头发变成了天上的星星，呼出的气变成了天上的云朵，汗水变成了雨水和露珠。他的手足和高大的鼻子变成了东西南北四极和大山，流淌的血变成了江河湖海。他的肌肉变成了肥沃的土地，牙齿和骨骼变成了各种金属和玉石，就连他的汗毛也变成了花草树木。
    盘古用他的身体创造了一个美丽的新世界。
fullText.traditional:
盤古開天地

    在太古時期，天地一片黑暗，分不清上下左右，東南西北。整個天地就像一顆巨大無比的“雞蛋”。
    不知道從什麼時候起，“雞蛋”裡孕育出了一個生命。這個生命就是中國的創世神——盤古。盤古在黑乎乎的“雞蛋”中沉睡了一萬八千年。
    一萬八千年後，盤古慢慢地睜開了眼睛。他發現眼前除了黑暗還是黑暗。他想伸展一下手和腳，卻被“雞蛋”包裹得緊緊的。盤古覺得非常不舒服，他想要打破這個“雞蛋”。
    於是他用自己的牙齒變了一把神斧。他拿起神斧用力地一砍，這顆“雞蛋”居然裂開了，神奇的事情發生了。“雞蛋”中比較輕的部分開始慢慢上昇變成了天，比較重的部分慢慢下沉變成了地。盤古頓時覺得輕鬆了許多。
    可是沒過一會兒，天又開始下沉了，地也在上昇。很快天和地又要合在一起了。於是盤古趕緊用手舉著天，腳踩著地，把天和地分開。天和地每天在不斷地上昇和下沉，盤古的身體也隨之長高。又過了一萬八千年，天和地再也沒有合併的跡象了。
    於是盤古放下舉著天空的雙手。他看了看世界，覺得世界什麼都沒有，空空的。於是，他用自己的左眼變成了火紅的太陽，用自己的右眼變成了銀色的月亮。他的頭髮變成了天上的星星，呼出的氣變成了天上的雲朵，汗水變成了雨水和露珠。他的手足和高大的鼻子變成了東西南北四極和大山，流淌的血變成了江河湖海。他的肌肉變成了肥沃的土地，牙齒和骨骼變成了各種金屬和玉石，就連他的汗毛也變成了花草樹木。
    盤古用他的身體創造了一個美麗的新世界。

sentences.english: Pangu Creates the World

sentences.simplified: 在太古时期，天地一片黑暗，
sentences.traditional: 在太古時期，天地一片黑暗，
sentences.pinyin: zài tài gǔ shí qī tiān dì yí piàn hēi àn

sentences.simplified: 分不清上下左右，东南西北。
sentences.traditional: 分不清上下左右，東南西北。
sentences.pinyin: fēn bù qīng shàng xià zuǒ yòu dōng nán xī běi
sentences.english: During the earliest times, the world was in total darkness.

sentences.simplified: 整个天地就像一颗巨大无比的“鸡蛋”。
sentences.traditional: 整個天地就像一顆巨大無比的“雞蛋”。
sentences.pinyin: zhěng gè tiān dì jiù xiàng yì kē jù dà wú bǐ de jī dàn
sentences.english: There was no way to differentiate between up, down, left, and right, nor north, south, east, and west.
The entire world was like a humongous “egg”.

sentences.simplified: 不知道从什么时候起，“鸡蛋”里孕育出了一个生命。这个生命就是中国的创世神——盘古。
sentences.traditional: 不知道從什麼時候起，“雞蛋”裡孕育出了一個生命。這個生命就是中國的創世神——盤古。
sentences.pinyin: bù zhī dào cóng shén me shí hou qǐ jī dàn lǐ yùn yù chū le yí ge shēng mìng zhè ge shēng mìng jiù shì zhōng guó de chuàng shì shén pán gǔ

sentences.simplified: 盘古在黑乎乎的“鸡蛋”中沉睡了一万八千年。
sentences.traditional: 盤古在黑乎乎的“雞蛋”中沉睡了一萬八千年。
sentences.pinyin: pán gǔ zài hēi hū hū de jī dàn zhōng chén shuì le yí wàn bā qiān nián
sentences.english: At some point, the “egg” conceived a life. This life was China’s Creator – Pangu.
Pangu was soundly asleep inside of the pitch black “egg” for eighteen thousand years.

sentences.simplified: 一万八千年后，盘古慢慢地睁开了眼睛。
sentences.traditional: 一萬八千年後，盤古慢慢地睜開了眼睛。
sentences.pinyin: yí wàn bā qiān nián hòu pán gǔ màn man de zhēng kāi le yǎn jing

sentences.simplified: 他发现眼前除了黑暗还是黑暗。
sentences.traditional: 他發現眼前除了黑暗還是黑暗。
sentences.pinyin: tā fā xiàn yǎn qián chú le hēi àn hái shì hēi àn
sentences.english: After eighteen thousand years, Pangu slowly opened his eyes.

sentences.simplified: 他想伸展一下手和脚，却被“鸡蛋”包裹得紧紧的。
sentences.traditional: 他想伸展一下手和腳，卻被“雞蛋”包裹得緊緊的。
sentences.pinyin: tā xiǎng shēn zhǎn yí xià shǒu hé jiǎo què bèi jī dàn bāo guǒ de jǐn jǐn de
sentences.english: He found that in front of his eyes, there was nothing by darkness.

sentences.simplified: 盘古觉得非常不舒服，他想要打破这个“鸡蛋”。
sentences.traditional: 盤古覺得非常不舒服，他想要打破這個“雞蛋”。
sentences.pinyin: pán gǔ jué de fēi cháng bù shū fu tā xiǎng yào dǎ pò zhè ge jī dàn
sentences.english: He wanted to stretch out his arms and legs, but was bound up tightly by the “egg”.
Pangu felt very uncomfortable and wanted to break this “egg”.

sentences.simplified: 于是他用自己的牙齿变了一把神斧。
sentences.traditional: 於是他用自己的牙齒變了一把神斧。
sentences.pinyin: yú shì tā yòng zì jǐ de yá chǐ biàn le yì bǎ shén fǔ

sentences.simplified: 他拿起神斧用力地一砍，这颗“鸡蛋”居然裂开了，神奇的事情发生了。
sentences.traditional: 他拿起神斧用力地一砍，這顆“雞蛋”居然裂開了，神奇的事情發生了。
sentences.pinyin: tā ná qǐ shén fǔ yòng lì de yì kǎn zhè kē jī dàn jū rán liè kāi le shén qí de shì qing fā shēng le
sentences.english: Thereupon, he used his own teeth to create a magical ax.

sentences.simplified: “鸡蛋”中比较轻的部分开始慢慢上升变成了天，
sentences.traditional: “雞蛋”中比較輕的部分開始慢慢上昇變成了天，
sentences.pinyin: jī dàn zhōng bǐ jiào qīng de bù fen kāi shǐ màn man shàng shēng biàn chéng le tiān
sentences.english: He picked up the magical ax and struck forcefully. This “egg” unexpectedly split open, and magical things happened.

sentences.simplified: 比较重的部分慢慢下沉变成了地。盘古顿时觉得轻松了许多。
sentences.traditional: 比較重的部分慢慢下沉變成了地。盤古頓時覺得輕鬆了許多。
sentences.pinyin: bǐ jiào zhòng de bù fen màn man xià chén biàn chéng le dì pán gǔ dùn shí jué de qīng sōng le xǔ duō
sentences.english: The lighter parts of the “egg” began to slowly rise, and became the sky.
The heavier parts slowly sank, and became the earth. Pangu immediately felt much more relaxed.

sentences.simplified: 可是没过一会儿，天又开始下沉了，地也在上升。
sentences.traditional: 可是沒過一會兒，天又開始下沉了，地也在上昇。
sentences.pinyin: kě shì méi guò yí huì'r tiān yòu kāi shǐ xià chén le dì yě zài shàng shēng

sentences.simplified: 很快天和地又要合在一起了。
sentences.traditional: 很快天和地又要合在一起了。
sentences.pinyin: hěn kuài tiān hé dì yòu yào hé zài yì qǐ le
sentences.english: But not long after, the sky began to sink again, and the earth started to rise.

sentences.simplified: 于是盘古赶紧用手举着天，脚踩着地，
sentences.traditional: 於是盤古趕緊用手舉著天，腳踩著地，
sentences.pinyin: yú shì pán gǔ gǎn jǐn yòng shǒu jǔ zhe tiān jiǎo cǎi zhe dì
sentences.english: The sky and the earth were going to join together again very soon.

sentences.simplified: 把天和地分开。
sentences.traditional: 把天和地分開。
sentences.pinyin: bǎ tiān hé dì fēn kāi
sentences.english: Thereupon, Pangu quickly used his hands to hold up the sky and his feet to tread on the earth, ..

sentences.simplified: 天和地每天在不断地上升和下沉，盘古的身体也随之长高。
sentences.traditional: 天和地每天在不斷地上昇和下沉，盤古的身體也隨之長高。
sentences.pinyin: tiān hé dì měi tiān zài bú duàn de shàng shēng hé xià chén pán gǔ de shēn tǐ yě suí zhī zhǎng gāo
sentences.english: .. separating the sky and the earth.

sentences.simplified: 又过了一万八千年，天和地再也没有合并的迹象了。
sentences.traditional: 又過了一萬八千年，天和地再也沒有合併的跡象了。
sentences.pinyin: yòu guò le yí wàn bā qiān nián tiān hé dì zài yě méi yǒu hé bìng de jì xiàng le
sentences.english: Every day, the sky rose and the earth sunk, and along with this, Pangu grew taller.
After another eighteen thousand years, there was no longer any sign of the sky and the earth joining together.

sentences.simplified: 于是盘古放下举着天空的双手。
sentences.traditional: 於是盤古放下舉著天空的雙手。
sentences.pinyin: yú shì pán gǔ fàng xià jǔ zhe tiān kōng de shuāng shǒu

sentences.simplified: 他看了看世界，觉得世界什么都没有，空空的。
sentences.traditional: 他看了看世界，覺得世界什麼都沒有，空空的。
sentences.pinyin: tā kàn le kàn shì jiè jué de shì jiè shén me dōu méi yǒu kōng kōng de
sentences.english: Thereupon, Pangu put down his hands that were holding up the sky.

sentences.simplified: 于是，他用自己的左眼变成了火红的太阳，
sentences.traditional: 於是，他用自己的左眼變成了火紅的太陽，
sentences.pinyin: yú shì tā yòng zì jǐ de zuǒ yǎn biàn chéng le huǒ hóng de tài yáng
sentences.english: He took a look at the world, and felt that the world didn’t have anything in it, that it was very empty.

sentences.simplified: 用自己的右眼变成了银色的月亮。
sentences.traditional: 用自己的右眼變成了銀色的月亮。
sentences.pinyin: yòng zì jǐ de yòu yǎn biàn chéng le yín sè de yuè liang
sentences.english: So, he took his own left eye and turned it into the blazing sun.

sentences.simplified: 他的头发变成了天上的星星，呼出的气变成了天上的云朵，
sentences.traditional: 他的頭髮變成了天上的星星，呼出的氣變成了天上的雲朵，
sentences.pinyin: tā de tóu fa biàn chéng le tiān shàng de xīng xing hū chū de qì biàn chéng le tiān shàng de yún duǒ
sentences.english: He took his right eye and turned it into the silver moon.

sentences.simplified: 汗水变成了雨水和露珠。
sentences.traditional: 汗水變成了雨水和露珠。
sentences.pinyin: hàn shuǐ biàn chéng le yǔ shuǐ hé lù zhū
sentences.english: His hair became the stars in the sky, the air he breathed out became the clouds in the sky, ..

sentences.simplified: 他的手足和高大的鼻子变成了东西南北四极和大山，
sentences.traditional: 他的手足和高大的鼻子變成了東西南北四極和大山，
sentences.pinyin: tā de shǒu zú hé gāo dà de bí zi biàn chéng le dōng xī nán běi sì jí hé dà shān
sentences.english: .. and his sweat became rain and dew.

sentences.simplified: 流淌的血变成了江河湖海。
sentences.traditional: 流淌的血變成了江河湖海。
sentences.pinyin: liú tǎng de xiě biàn chéng le jiāng hé hú hǎi
sentences.english: His hands, his feet, and his tall nose became the four extremes of north, south, east, and west and the great mountains.

sentences.simplified: 他的肌肉变成了肥沃的土地，牙齿和骨骼变成了各种金属和玉石，
sentences.traditional: 他的肌肉變成了肥沃的土地，牙齒和骨骼變成了各種金屬和玉石，
sentences.pinyin: tā de jī ròu biàn chéng le féi wò de tǔ dì yá chǐ hé gǔ gé biàn chéng le gè zhǒng jīn shǔ hé yù shí
sentences.english: His flowing blood became the rivers, lakes, and oceans.

sentences.simplified: 就连他的汗毛也变成了花草树木。
sentences.traditional: 就連他的汗毛也變成了花草樹木。
sentences.pinyin: jiù lián tā de hàn máo yě biàn chéng le huā cǎo shù mù
sentences.english: His muscles became fertile soil, and his teeth and bones became various kinds of metals and precious stones.
Even the hairs on his body became flowers and trees.

sentences.simplified: 盘古用他的身体创造了一个美丽的新世界。
sentences.traditional: 盤古用他的身體創造了一個美麗的新世界。
sentences.pinyin: pán gǔ yòng tā de shēn tǐ chuàng zào le yí ge měi lì de xīn shì jiè

sentences.english: Pangu used his body to create a beautiful, new world.

sentence_translations: Pangu Creates the World
During the earliest times, the world was in total darkness.
There was no way to differentiate between up, down, left, and right, nor north, south, east, and west.
The entire world was like a humongous “egg”.
At some point, the “egg” conceived a life. This life was China’s Creator – Pangu.
Pangu was soundly asleep inside of the pitch black “egg” for eighteen thousand years.
After eighteen thousand years, Pangu slowly opened his eyes.
He found that in front of his eyes, there was nothing by darkness.
He wanted to stretch out his arms and legs, but was bound up tightly by the “egg”.
Pangu felt very uncomfortable and wanted to break this “egg”.
Thereupon, he used his own teeth to create a magical ax.
He picked up the magical ax and struck forcefully. This “egg” unexpectedly split open, and magical things happened.
The lighter parts of the “egg” began to slowly rise, and became the sky.
The heavier parts slowly sank, and became the earth. Pangu immediately felt much more relaxed.
But not long after, the sky began to sink again, and the earth started to rise.
The sky and the earth were going to join together again very soon.
Thereupon, Pangu quickly used his hands to hold up the sky and his feet to tread on the earth, ..
.. separating the sky and the earth.
Every day, the sky rose and the earth sunk, and along with this, Pangu grew taller.
After another eighteen thousand years, there was no longer any sign of the sky and the earth joining together.
Thereupon, Pangu put down his hands that were holding up the sky.
He took a look at the world, and felt that the world didn’t have anything in it, that it was very empty.
So, he took his own left eye and turned it into the blazing sun.
He took his right eye and turned it into the silver moon.
His hair became the stars in the sky, the air he breathed out became the clouds in the sky, ..
.. and his sweat became rain and dew.
His hands, his feet, and his tall nose became the four extremes of north, south, east, and west and the great mountains.
His flowing blood became the rivers, lakes, and oceans.
His muscles became fertile soil, and his teeth and bones became various kinds of metals and precious stones.
Even the hairs on his body became flowers and trees.
Pangu used his body to create a beautiful, new world.
